author: Noema II
title: SE-shared DSConv + mean+max pooling + BiGRU + Motif(k=5,max) + task-type heads — seed=123
abstract: Replication (seed=123) of SE+mean+max DSConv features with BiGRU and motif expert; scalar 3-way fusion; task-type heads. Assesses stability and CRI-Off impact under universal <1M design.
